parameters.query:
WITH active_mappings AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', fcr.id,
                'type', fcr.type,
                'usecase_id', fcr.usecase_id,
                'minvalue', fcr.minvalue,
                'maxvalue', fcr.maxvalue,
                'minpulses', fcr.minpulses,
                'maxpulses', fcr.maxpulses,
                'minintensity', fcr.minintensity,
                'maxintensity', fcr.maxintensity,
                'minduration', fcr.minduration,
                'maxduration', fcr.maxduration,
                'mininterval', fcr.mininterval,
                'maxinterval', fcr.maxinterval,
                'active', fcr.active,

                'historical_assignment_count', (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM public."User_UC_Mappings" history
                    WHERE history.feedback_config_rule_id = fcr.id
                ),

                'active_assignment_count', (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM public."User_UC_Mappings" current_assignment
                    WHERE current_assignment.feedback_config_rule_id = fcr.id
                      AND current_assignment.active = true
                )
            )
            ORDER BY
                fcr.minvalue NULLS FIRST,
                fcr.id
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS mappings
    FROM public.feedback_config_rules fcr
    WHERE fcr.usecase_id = $1
      AND fcr.active = true
      AND fcr.id <> 9999
),

sensor_statistics AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(MIN(sd.value)::numeric, 2) AS min_seen,
        ROUND(MAX(sd.value)::numeric, 2) AS max_seen,
        ROUND(AVG(sd.value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_seen,
        ROUND(STDDEV_POP(sd.value)::numeric, 2) AS stddev_seen,
        COUNT(*) AS total_readings,
        MIN(sd.time) AS first_reading_at,
        MAX(sd.time) AS last_reading_at
    FROM public."SensorData" sd
    WHERE sd.usecase_id = $1
      AND sd.time > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
      AND (
          $2::integer IS NULL
          OR sd.userid = $2::integer
      )
),

selected_user_mapping AS (
    SELECT
        jsonb_build_object(
            'assignment_id', uum.id,
            'user_id', uum.user_id,
            'mapping_id', uum.feedback_config_rule_id,
            'active', uum.active,
            'assigned_at', uum.assigned_at,
            'deactivated_at', uum.deactivated_at,

            'mapping', jsonb_build_object(
                'id', fcr.id,
                'type', fcr.type,
                'usecase_id', fcr.usecase_id,
                'minvalue', fcr.minvalue,
                'maxvalue', fcr.maxvalue,
                'minpulses', fcr.minpulses,
                'maxpulses', fcr.maxpulses,
                'minintensity', fcr.minintensity,
                'maxintensity', fcr.maxintensity,
                'minduration', fcr.minduration,
                'maxduration', fcr.maxduration,
                'mininterval', fcr.mininterval,
                'maxinterval', fcr.maxinterval,
                'active', fcr.active
            )
        ) AS assignment

    FROM public."User_UC_Mappings" uum

    JOIN public.feedback_config_rules fcr
      ON fcr.id = uum.feedback_config_rule_id

    WHERE $2::integer IS NOT NULL
      AND uum.user_id = $2::integer
      AND uum.active = true
      AND fcr.usecase_id = $1
      AND fcr.id <> 9999

    ORDER BY
        uum.assigned_at DESC NULLS LAST,
        uum.id DESC

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    uc.usecase_id,
    uc.name AS usecase_name,

    active_mappings.mappings AS current_mappings,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'window_days', 30,

        'scope',
            CASE
                WHEN $2::integer IS NULL
                    THEN 'all participants'
                ELSE 'selected participant'
            END,

        'user_id', $2::integer,
        'min_seen', sensor_statistics.min_seen,
        'max_seen', sensor_statistics.max_seen,
        'avg_seen', sensor_statistics.avg_seen,
        'stddev_seen', sensor_statistics.stddev_seen,
        'total_readings', sensor_statistics.total_readings,
        'first_reading_at', sensor_statistics.first_reading_at,
        'last_reading_at', sensor_statistics.last_reading_at
    ) AS sensor_statistics,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT assignment
            FROM selected_user_mapping
        ),
        'null'::jsonb
    ) AS selected_user_mapping

FROM public."UseCase" uc

CROSS JOIN active_mappings
CROSS JOIN sensor_statistics

WHERE uc.usecase_id = $1;

parameters.text:
={{
"You are the read-only Mapping Design Expert for the Smartwatch Haptic research system.\n\n" +

"Your role is to propose and critique draft sensor-to-vibration mappings. " +
"You must never claim to create, save, assign, activate, deactivate, delete, " +
"or modify a mapping. All proposals are drafts that require explicit researcher " +
"confirmation and later deterministic processing by Mapping Manager.\n\n" +

"Important design rules:\n" +
"1. Mapping ID 9999 is a protected fallback and must never be proposed for modification.\n" +
"2. Do not make medical, diagnostic, or clinical claims.\n" +
"3. Do not describe mappings as alerts for danger, health concerns, medical events, " +
"or situations requiring immediate attention.\n" +
"4. Describe differences using noticeability, interruption level, feedback strength, " +
"interpretability, and possible feedback burden.\n" +
"5. Use only the supplied database context. Do not invent existing mappings, " +
"sensor statistics, assignments, or database records.\n" +
"6. Every proposal must include all ten mapping parameters.\n" +
"7. The sensor range must satisfy minvalue < maxvalue.\n" +
"8. Pulse, intensity, duration, and interval values must be numeric and non-negative.\n" +
"9. Do not automatically reorder min/max haptic parameters. Duration or interval " +
"may intentionally decrease as sensor values increase.\n" +
"10. Explain overlaps, gaps, noticeability differences, burden risks, and tradeoffs.\n" +
"11. When recent sensor data is absent, state that proposals are conceptual and " +
"must not be presented as data-derived personalization.\n" +
"12. Produce between one and three proposals depending on the request.\n" +
"13. Do not include Markdown code fences.\n\n" +

"Return exactly one valid JSON object using this structure:\n" +
JSON.stringify({
  reply:
    "Plain-language summary that explicitly states nothing was saved or assigned.",
  warnings: [],
  proposals: [
    {
      proposal_id: "p1",
      label: "Short descriptive label",
      params: {
        minvalue: 0,
        maxvalue: 0,
        minpulses: 0,
        maxpulses: 0,
        minintensity: 0,
        maxintensity: 0,
        minduration: 0,
        maxduration: 0,
        mininterval: 0,
        maxinterval: 0
      },
      rationale:
        "Why this draft fits the researcher request and supplied context.",
      tradeoffs: [
        "A concrete noticeability, interruption, interpretability, or burden tradeoff"
      ],
      warnings: [],
      source_refs: []
    }
  ],
  recommended_actions: [
    {
      action: "review_proposal",
      proposal_id: "p1",
      label: "Review this draft"
    }
  ]
}, null, 2) +

"\n\nResearcher request:\n" +
$json.message +

"\n\nSelected use case:\n" +
JSON.stringify({
  usecase_id: $json.usecase_id,
  usecase_name: $json.usecase_name
}, null, 2) +

"\n\nSelected participant context:\n" +
JSON.stringify({
  user_id: $json.user_id,
  current_assignment: $json.selected_user_mapping
}, null, 2) +

"\n\nCurrent active mappings:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.current_mappings ?? [],
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nRecent sensor statistics:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.sensor_statistics ?? {},
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nAdditional application context:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.context ?? {},
  null,
  2
) +

"\n\nExisting context warnings:\n" +
JSON.stringify(
  $json.context_warnings ?? [],
  null,
  2
)
}}
